app.name: Family Planner
app.summary: Combines multiple family calendars clearly onto a single tile.
app.option_title_hint: Optional title at the top of the tile
app.option_calendars_hint: Comma-separated entity IDs, e.g. calendar.anna, calendar.max, calendar.family
app.option_calendar_names_hint: Comma-separated names in matching order, e.g. Anna, Max, Family
app.option_calendar_colors_hint: Comma-separated hex colors in matching order, e.g. #3B82F6, #10B981, #F59E0B
app.option_max_items_hint: Maximum number of events shown across all calendars
app.option_show_calendar_hint: Displays the calendar or family member label on each event
